Where Nagaoka
meets the world.
home.hero.lead: International events across the city, the groups that run them, and reports from past activities — everything about international exchange in Nagaoka, gathered in one place. Available in Japanese, Japanese with furigana, and English.

home.guide.title: New here?
home.guide.lead: Three steps to find the right place for you.
home.guide.step1.title: Search
home.guide.step1.body: Filter events by genre, area and date. Each event shows which languages are supported.
home.guide.step2.title: Apply
home.guide.step2.body: Events that need registration show a deadline and contact details. Some accept walk-ins.
home.guide.step3.title: Join
home.guide.step3.body: Coming alone is perfectly fine. Read the reports to see what it is really like.
